core_obligations: Express the surjective rectangular permanent through smaller standard permanents.
Use Binet-Minc formulas while preserving row set-multilinearity.
Convert products of polynomial components to sums of surjective permanents over disjoint block partitions.
Simulate each circuit gate with bounded-size set-multilinear gadgets and track the product-depth doubling.
difficulty_reason: The author directly set-multilinearizes multiplication gates using surjective rectangular permanents and Binet-Minc formulas over arbitrary characteristic. The disjoint-block partition construction and gate simulation give a nonroutine explicit circuit transformation distinct from the logical lower-bound transfer.

dedup.scope: Root and lane reference snapshots have zero source DOI/title hits. Target Corollary27 is the independent constructive circuit-conversion contribution; sibling Theorem10 is an IMM lower-bound result obtained by logical rank transfer. All permanent and component-gadget lemmas are uncounted support.

compared.difference: Explicit characteristic-free conversion of arbitrary circuits to set-multilinear projections versus an iterated-matrix-multiplication size lower bound.
